entities.name: miR-103a
observations: The 2016 AMI study reports miR-103a targeted Piezo1 and reduced Piezo1 protein expression in endothelial-cell experiments.

entities.name: PIEZO1
observations: Reported target of miR-103a in a luciferase reporter assay; miR-103a reduced Piezo1 protein in HUVEC experiments.

entities.name: Acute myocardial infarction
observations: A 2016 study found plasma miR-103a elevated in AMI patients; the abstract does not establish in-vivo causality for infarction.

entities.name: PMID:27515482
observations: Study assessed patient miR-103a levels, luciferase targeting of Piezo1, and HUVEC tube formation and viability; miR-103a reduced both endothelial readouts.

entities.name: miR-103a endothelial AMI finding
observations: In the 2016 study, miR-103a targeted Piezo1 and reduced Piezo1 protein, HUVEC capillary tube formation, and cell viability; patient plasma miR-103a was elevated in AMI. Abstract evidence is not an in-vivo causal demonstration.
